name: Central Seat Allocation Board
conducting_body: Ministry of Education, Government of India
scope: Special / supernumerary round seat allocation for NITs, IIITs, IIEST and Other-GFTIs for vacant seats remaining after JoSAA

csab_special.description: Conducted after JoSAA to fill remaining vacant seats across NITs, IIITs, IIEST and Other-GFTIs

csab_neut.full_name: CSAB for North Eastern and Union Territories (NEUT)
csab_neut.description: Special round for candidates from North Eastern States and Union Territories to allocate seats in AICTE-approved institutes under the reservation scheme for States and UTs lacking such facilities.

eligibility.jee_main: Candidates who have appeared in JEE (Main) and meet the eligibility criteria of the participating institutes
eligibility.note: Candidates who have already secured and retained a JoSAA-allotted NIT+ seat can participate in CSAB Special without surrendering it first. If no new seat is allotted, the JoSAA seat is retained; if a new CSAB seat is allotted, the retained JoSAA seat is automatically cancelled.

process.registration: Separate online registration on csab.nic.in after JoSAA concludes
process.choice_filling: Fresh choice filling specific to CSAB participating institutes and programmes
process.rounds: Typically 2 rounds for CSAB Special; additional rounds possible
process.reporting: Document verification and reporting at the allotted institute as per CSAB schedule

fee_note: Seat acceptance / processing fees published in the CSAB business rules each year
